coding_principle: Code the observable change and violated relation, not an inferred mental state and not the CodeQL symptom alone.

root_cause_categories.label: Incomplete change coordination
root_cause_categories.definition: The PR changes an implementation or introduces a new element without completely coordinating the code entities that must be removed, connected, or updated together.

submechanisms.definition: Replacement, deletion, or abandonment makes an existing element obsolete, but the element remains in the head revision.
A newly introduced declaration, dependency, state member, or operation is never connected to a consumer or effect.
A related change is applied at some dependent sites but not all sites that share the changed relation.

root_cause_categories.boundary: Use contract mismatch when the central evidence is disagreement with an explicit API/type contract; use redundant construction when the element merely duplicates an effective operation rather than being left obsolete or unintegrated.

root_cause_categories.label: Interface or contract mismatch
root_cause_categories.definition: Changed code invokes, overrides, exports, documents, or consumes an interface using a contract inconsistent with its observable declaration or supported behavior.

submechanisms.definition: Argument names, counts, or callability disagree with the callee.
An override, type, or initialization obligation disagrees with its base contract.
Exports, documentation targets, or annotations refer to a declaration that does not match.
Code selects a deprecated API or calls a language/library operation without the required visible declaration.

root_cause_categories.boundary: The contract must be evidenced by code or project metadata, not inferred from likely intent.

root_cause_categories.label: Control-, state-, or data-flow miscomposition
root_cause_categories.definition: The PR composes branches, loops, returns, assignments, expressions, or state transitions so that an anomalous execution or value-flow state follows.

submechanisms.definition: Branch/loop/return structure creates an unreachable, trivial, mixed-return, or finally-exit path.
A value may be read before initialization, or a written state has no effective consumer.
Operands, expressions, null handling, or value composition cannot produce the intended effective state.

root_cause_categories.boundary: Use incomplete coordination when the anomaly is principally a leftover or unsynchronized code entity rather than execution/value-flow composition.

root_cause_categories.label: Dependency, error, or resource mismanagement
root_cause_categories.definition: The PR constructs module dependencies, failure paths, or resource lifecycles in a way that violates an observable structural or cleanup obligation.

submechanisms.definition: New or redirected dependency edges create cycles, unsafe initialization order, or duplicate import paths.
A required failure is uncaught/ignored or an empty/broad handler defeats the relevant behavior.
A resource is not closed or released on all relevant paths.

root_cause_categories.boundary: Ordinary caller/callee disagreement belongs to interface or contract mismatch; this category requires dependency structure, failure handling, or resource-lifecycle evidence.

root_cause_categories.label: Redundant or locally inconsistent construction
root_cause_categories.definition: The PR adds or retains a duplicate, effect-free, avoidably inefficient, or locally inconsistent construction whose anomaly follows from comparison with an equivalent operation or an evidenced project convention.

submechanisms.definition: Definitions, imports, assignments, expressions, or operands duplicate another effective element.
Syntax, formatting, comments, or annotations violate an observable surrounding convention.
The chosen operation or composition performs avoidable work relative to an evidenced equivalent path.

root_cause_categories.boundary: Do not place merely unused new elements here; those are incomplete change coordination unless duplication is the central mechanism.

non_category_dispositions.definition: The issue is confirmed, but available diff/context does not support a defensible mechanism beyond the symptom. This is an audit disposition, not a sixth root-cause category.
